Criteria for Approval:
• Diagnosis of chronic heart failure that is symptomatic; AND
• Documentation (e.g., progress note) of:
○ Left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) ≤ 35%; AND
○ Resting heart rate ≥ 70 beats per minute (bpm); AND
• Used in combination with maximally tolerated doses of a beta blocker (e.g., bisoprolol, carvedilol, or metoprolol succinate); OR
• Documentation (e.g., progress note) of clinical rationale preventing use of a beta-blocker.
